newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo attracts $700 mln foreign investment in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Yugo attracts $700 mln foreign investment in 1996.

text.p: Yugoslavia attracted around $700 million in foreign investment last year and could expect more capital in 1997, Tanjug news agency reported on Friday.

The capital entered the country through more than 1,000 joint stock companies established with foreign partners, Tanjug said quoting Yugoslav deputy foreign trade minister Predrag Maksimovic as saying.
Maksimovic said 146 foreign investment deals have been signed since the beginning of 1997, bringing a fresh $12 million to the country.

The government singled out agriculture, food-processing, wood-processing and metal-processing industries as the most lucrative targets for foreign capital. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
